name: Sugimoto Tatsumi
source:
A guy who struggled getting a regular job was called out by his uncle to be his temporary caretaker due to an injury caused by an accident. At first Tatsumi wasn't very enthusiastic about helping, but he became more motivated after he found out that a woman he liked lives in his uncle's housing complex. 

[translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=52661]Getchu[/url].]
